summary: Remote-shell agent with Anthropic API key harvesting and host fingerprinting
details: The package ships a darwin/amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt that opens an outbound WebSocket to the hardcoded author-controlled endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/creack/pty to spawn a pseudo-terminal, providing an interactive remote shell into the installer's host driven by the remote side of the WebSocket. The same binary contains a regex tuned to Anthropic secret keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) together with references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, indicating harvesting of installer-owned Claude/Anthropic API credentials. It additionally calls http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query to fingerprint the installer's public IP, country, city, and timezone, which is transmitted alongside the WebSocket channel to relay.sextant.top. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository literally named claude_control, consistent with the binary's remote-agent and Anthropic-credential-scraping behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
